out_items.name: Certified Food Protection Manager

violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: A certified food manager was not present at the beginning of the inspection
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. A CERTIFIED FOOD MANAGER ARRIVED DURING THE INSPECTION. A CERTIFIED FOOD MANAGER MUST BE PRESENT AT ALL HOURS OF FOOD PREPARATION

out_items.name: Required records available: shellstock tags, parasite destruction

violations.title: Shellstock Label Marked, Last Date Served/Sold Info
violations.observation: Nearly half of the retained shellstock tags were observed with no dates written on the tags
violations.corrective_action: The identity of the source of shellstock (oysters, clams, mussels) that are sold or served shall be maintained by retaining shellstock tags or labels and marking the tag or label with the date when the last shellstock from the container is sold or served. EHS PROVIDED PIC WITH SHELLSTOCK TAG GUIDANCE IN ENGLISH AND SPANISH. THE DATE THAT THE LAST PIECE WAS SOLD MUST BE WRITTEN ON THE TAG. TAGS MUST BE RETAINED FOR 90 DAYS.

out_items.name: Food-contact surfaces cleaned and sanitized

violations.title: Food Contact Surface, Clean after Use
violations.observation: Observed food debris on the meat slicer. Meat slicer was not used recently
violations.corrective_action: Equipment food-contact surfaces and utensils shall be cleaned at any time during the operation when contamination may have occurred. PIC INSTRUCTED STAFF TO BEGIN CLEANING AND SANITIZING THE MEAT SLICER.

out_items.name: Proper cold holding temperatures

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: 1) in the 2DR under counter glass, right, bar cooler: half and half (50f), condensed milk (60f) 2) at ambient temperature: pho broth (52f). Upon discussion with staff, pho broth was taken out of the walk-in cooler less than 2 hours prior to inspection
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. STAFF DISCARDED THE HALF AND HALF AND CONDENSED MILK. PIC MOVED THE PHO BROTH INTO THE WALK-IN COOLER TO CHILL TO 41f.

out_items.name: Proper date marking and disposition

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: Observed no date marking on soups and sauces
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC TO PLACE DATES ON ANY FOOD THAT IS STORED FOR MORE THAN 24 HOURS.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Storage of Poison/Toxic Materials
violations.observation: Observed a can of WD-40 and a can of Clorox wipes being stored with single-service items at the bar. Observed multiple bottles of cleaning products being stored with clean dishes at the bar.
violations.corrective_action: All poisonous and toxic materials shall be stored below food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items to prevent contamination. PIC MOVED ALL THE CLEANING PRODUCTS TO A SEPARATE CLEANING SUPPLY STORAGE AREA.

violations.title: Storage-Personal Care Items
violations.observation: Observed personal medication being stored on a food preparation shelf in the kitchen. Observed personal medication being stored along single-service items at the bar.
violations.corrective_action: All employees' personal care items shall be stored in a way that prevents the contamination of food and food contact surfaces through improper labeling or storage. PIC MOVED REMOVED ALL MEDICATION AND PLACED THEM WITH EMPLOYEE ITEMS.

out_items.name: Certified Food Protection Manager

violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: A certified food manager was not present at the beginning of the inspection
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. A CERTIFIED FOOD MANAGER ARRIVED DURING THE INSPECTION. HAVE MULTIPLE STAFF MEMBERS BECOME CERTIFIED FOOD MANAGERS. A CERTIFIED FOOD MANAGER MUST BE PRESENT AT ALL TIMES OF FOOD PREPARATION.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Signage
violations.observation: Observed no hand washing signs posted at the hand sink in the kitchen and in the bathrooms
violations.corrective_action: Provide a visible sign or poster at all handwashing sinks used by food employees that reminds food employees to wash their hands. EHS PROVIDED PIC WITH THREE HAND WASHING SIGNS.

out_items.name: Required records available: shellstock tags, parasite destruction

violations.title: Approved Record Keeping, Tags/Labels
violations.observation: Mussel shellstock tags were observed being stored in no particular order in a small metal container in the kitchen. Dates were observed only written on some tags.
violations.corrective_action: Tags/labels must be maintained in chronological order by the date recorded on the tag/label when the last shellstock is used/sold. EHS INSTRUCTED STAFF AND PIC TO KEEP THE TAG WITH THE BATCH OF MUSSELS. WHEN THE LAST PIECE IS SOLD, WRITE THE DATE ON THE TAG AND RETAIN FOR 90 DAYS. ORGANIZE IN CHRONOLOGICAL ORDER.

out_items.name: Proper cold holding temperatures

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: 1) pho broth was observed at 46f at ambient temperature. Broth was taken out of the walk-in 1 hour prior to inspection; 2) peanut sauce was observed at 63f at ambient temperature; 3) condensed milk was observed at 65f at ambient temperature.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. STAFF MOVED PHO BROTH INTO THE WALK-IN TO COOL TO 41f. STAFF DISCARDED THE PEANUT SAUCE AND CONDENSED MILK.

out_items.name: Food additives; approved and properly used

violations.title: Approved Additives
violations.observation: Observed Hawaiian-style Black Lava Salt containing activated charcoal being used to garish cocktail glasses.
violations.corrective_action: Food may not contain unapproved food additives or additives that exceed amounts specified in 21 CFR 170-180 relating to food additives, generally recognized as safe or prior sanctioned substances that exceed amounts specified in 21 CFR 181-186, substances that exceed amounts specified in 9 CFR Subpart C Section 424.21(b) Food ingredients and sources of radiation, or pesticide residues that exceed provisions specified in 40 CFR 180 Tolerances for pesticides chemicals in food, and exceptions. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO DISCARD THE BLACK LAVA SALT BECAUSE IT CONTAINS ACTIVATED CHARCOAL. ACTIVATED CHARCOAL IS AN UNAPPROVED FOOD ADDITIVE. CORRECT BY THE FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Separation of Poison/Toxic Materials
violations.observation: Observed multiple bottles of bleach and soap being stored on a shelf above the 3 compartment sink next to food. Observed several bottles of cleaning products being stored next to single service items at the bar
violations.corrective_action: All poisonous and toxic materials shall be stored to prevent contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items by separating the poisonous and toxic materials by spacing or partitioning. STORE ALL CHEMICAL PRODUCTS IN AN AREA THAT DOES NOT CONTAMINATE FOOD OR FOOD- RELATED ITEMS. CORRECT BY THE FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

violations.title: Common Name, Working Containers
violations.observation: Observed two unlabeled spray bottles of clear, bubbly liquid
violations.corrective_action: Label all working containers of poisonous and toxic materials, including cleaners and sanitizers, with a common name to prevent the dangerous misuse of these materials. LABEL ALL CHEMICAL BOTTLES. CORRECT BY THE FOLLOW UP INSPECTION. LANTERN HOUSE KITCHEN BAR (Inspection Date: 02/26/2026) Page 2 of 4

violations.title: Storage-Personal Care Items
violations.observation: Observed a bottle of OTC medication being stored on food preparation table.
violations.corrective_action: All employees' personal care items shall be stored in a way that prevents the contamination of food and food contact surfaces through improper labeling or storage. STAFF MOVED THE PERSONAL CARE ITEM TO THEIR PERSONAL BELONGINGS

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Observed food being stored on the floor of the walk-in freezer and walk-in cooler.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. ELEVATE ALL FOOD OFF OF THE FLOOR TO FACILITATE ROUTINE CLEANING.

out_items.name: In-use utensils properly stored

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Observed two knives being stored in between a prep top cooler and a prep table
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC TO DIFFERENT METHODS OF STORING KNIVES AT THE WORK STATION. PIC MOVED THE KNIVES TO THE DISHWASHER

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items No Reuse
violations.observation: Manufacturer containers of garlic and fried onions were observed being reused to stored different sauces throughout the walk-in cooler
violations.corrective_action: Manufacturer containers may not be reused for secondary storage of other foods because the containers are not durable enough for multiple reuse and become uncleanable. DO NOT REUSED MANUFACTURER CONTAINERS. REPLACE WITH NSF-APPROVED, FOOD GRADE FOOD STORAGE CONTAINERS.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, Durable/Smooth Materials
violations.observation: Observed aluminum foil being used to line shelving along the cook line.
violations.corrective_action: Non-food contact surfaces of equipment that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other foods that require frequent cleaning shall be constructed of a corrosion- resistant, nonabsorbent, and smooth material. REMOVE ALL FOIL TO REDUCE HARBORAGE CONDITIONS. MORE FREQUENT CLEANING IS REQUIRED.

violations.title: Food-Contact Surfaces, Corrosion-Resistant/Nonabsorbent Materials
violations.observation: Observed a large plastic tote being used to store food in the walk-in cooler
violations.corrective_action: Materials that are used in the construction of utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment may not allow the migration of deleterious substances or impart colors, odors, or tastes to food and under normal use conditions shall be durable, corrosion-resistant, and nonabsorbent. REPLACE WITH NSF-APPROVED, FOOD GRADE STORAGE CONTAINERS. LANTERN HOUSE KITCHEN BAR (Inspection Date: 02/26/2026) Page 3 of 4

out_items.name: Non-food contact surfaces clean

violations.title: Equipment Clean to Sight and Touch
violations.observation: Encrusted grease deposits and/or other soil deposits were observed on the food contact surfaces of the following cooking equipment: blender
violations.corrective_action: The food-contact surfaces of cooking equipment and pans shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other soil accumulations. A surface that is soiled cannot be effectively sanitized. CLEAN BLENDER

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed the hood filters above the grill with accumulated grease
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. CLEAN FILTERS ROUTINELY

out_items.name: Adequate ventilation and lighting, designated areas used

violations.title: Lockers, Provided
violations.observation: Lockers or other suitable facilities are not provided for employees clothing and other possessions. Observed staff’s personal belongings being stored on top of food and equipment on a shelf by the walk-in.
violations.corrective_action: Provide proper storage facilities for employees' personal belongings to prevent contamination of food, food equipment, and food contact surfaces. DESIGNATE AN AREA FOR STAFF TO PUT THEIR BELONGINGS THAT DO NOT CONTAMINATE FOOD OR FOOD-RELATED ITEMS.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Access to Handwashing Sink
violations.observation: A cutting board and a pair of scissors were observed in the basin of the hand sink in the kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: A hand washing sink shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for employee use. PIC MOVED THE CUTTING BOARD AND THE SCISSORS TO THE THREE COMPARTMENT SINK. THE HAND SINK MUST BE FULLY ACCESSIBLE TO FACILITATE PROPER HAND WASHING.

out_items.name: Food separated and protected

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Observed Raw chicken and Raw shrimp being stored over Ready-to-Eat food in the walk-in cooler.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. STAFF MOVED THE RAW CHICKEN AND RAW SHRIMP OUT OF THE WALK-IN TO PREPARE IT. STORE RAW PROTEINS BELOW AND SEPARATED FROM ALL COOKED FOOD, PRODUCE, LEFTOVERS, ETC. SEE PREVENTING CROSS CONTAMINATION HAND OUT.

out_items.name: Proper date marking and disposition

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: leftover rice, pho broth, prepared sauces (ie: chili sauce, fish sauce, etc.), picked carrots and pickled radish, etc.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC THAT ALL PREPARED FOODS AND ALL COOKED FOODS NEED TO BE DATE MARKED WITH THE DATE IT WAS PREPARED. SELL OR DISCARD WITHIN 7 DAYS. SEE DATE MARKING HAND OUT. LANTERN HOUSE KITCHEN BAR (Inspection Date: 09/02/2025) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Consumer advisory provided for raw and undercooked food

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food, Reminder
violations.observation: The following raw and/or undercooked foods are provided on the menu, menu board, table tent or brochure without a reminder statement: 1) Fall off the Bone Stone Pot; 2) Pho-nomenal Adventure; 3) Pho Stone Pot; 4) Shaking Beef were observed without a consumer advisory reminder asterisk *
violations.corrective_action: The Consumer Advisory shall include a reminder statement that includes asterisking (*) the animal-derived foods requiring disclosure to a footnote that states one of the following: 1) 'Regarding the safety of these items, written information is available upon request', or 2) 'Consuming raw or undercooked meats, seafood, shellfish, or eggs may increase your risk of foodborne illness', or 3) 'Consuming raw or undercooked meats, seafood, shellfish, or eggs may increase your risk of foodborne illness, especially if you have certain medical conditions'. PLACE A CONSUMER ADVISORY REMINDER ASTERISK * NEXT TO THE AFOREMENTIONED FOOD ITEMS TO INDICATE THESE FOODS CAN BE SERVED RAW/UNDERCOOKED. MAKE THIS CORRECTION BY THE FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Storage of Poison/Toxic Materials
violations.observation: Observed a spray bottle of glass cleaners next to food on a food preparation.
violations.corrective_action: All poisonous and toxic materials shall be stored below food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items to prevent contamination. PIC MOVED THE GLASS CLEANER TO THE CHEMICAL STORAGE AREA.

out_items.name: Approved thawing methods used

violations.title: Proper thawing methods used for TCS Foods
violations.observation: Observed the following food thawing using an improper method: frozen chicken was observed sitting in an empty basin of the 3 compartment sink.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be thawed using one of the following methods: 1) under refrigeration that maintains the food temperature at 41F or less, 2) completely submerged under running water at a water temperature of 70F or below with a sufficient velocity to agitate and float off loose particles of food as long as held for period of time at a temperature of 41F or less, or 3) as part of a cooking process if the food is cooked as specified by Law or thawed in a microwave oven and immediately transferred to a conventional cooking process. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO THAW FROZEN CHICKEN UNDER COLD RUNNING WATER.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food was observed being stored directly on the floor of the walk-in cooler and walk-in freezer.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. ELEVATE ALL FOOD OFF OF THE FLOOR TO FACILITATE PROPER CLEANING AND ORGANIZATION.

out_items.name: Food-contact surfaces cleaned and sanitized

violations.title: Chemical Sanitization, Chlorine Requirements
violations.observation: When tested, the low temperature, chemical sanitizing warewashing machine was observed with a sanitizing rinse concentration of less than 50 ppm chlorine solution.
violations.corrective_action: Immediately discontinue use of the dishmachine. Until the machine is adequately repaired, set up the three-compartment sink to manually wash, rinse and sanitize food-contact surfaces using a sanitizing solution at the proper concentration of at least 50 to 200 ppm total chlorine.

violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage.
